tagline: A familiar shop. A fresh start.
intro: Set up your space in your language. Your store, your choices, one step at a time.
loginBody: Sign in with your mobile number. We use it to create or find your merchant account and send a sign-in code.
otpBody: Enter the six-digit code. It expires in five minutes; you have up to five attempts.
development: Development preview: no SMS is sent. Use 123456. Use test details only.
smsNote: SMS delivery needs a configured provider. Development mode is available only when the server explicitly enables it.
webOtpFailed: Automatic code entry is unavailable. Enter or paste your code instead.
languageTitle: A language that feels like home.
languageBody: Choose your screen language and the language you want to speak. English and Hindi interface copy is ready; other choices currently use English fallback. Live speech comes in Phase 6.
previewPhrase: Welcome. Let’s set up your shop.
storeBody: Add your store and owner names. You can return to these steps later.
locationBody: Enter your six-digit PIN code. Your region is resolved by the server. Optional location is rounded to two decimals before it leaves your device.
locationConfirm: Suggested PIN code — check it before you continue.
unknownRegion: This PIN is not in the bundled directory. We will use its first three digits as a regional fallback.
locationFailed: We could not suggest a nearby PIN. Enter your PIN manually.
upiBody: Add your UPI ID and payee name. These are saved for future payment setup. This step does not collect money or verify ownership of a UPI account.
qrHelp: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 300 KB. Upload your own QR; it is not payment confirmation.
noQr: Your uploaded QR will appear here. No payment is requested.
noPayment: Preview only · Payment integration is planned for Phase 9.
speechNote: Text preview only. Read-aloud arrives in Phase 6.
unavailableBody: We could not check your session. Reconnect and try again. The public website and sample prototype remain available.

errors.OTP_INVALID: That code is incorrect, expired, used, or has reached its attempt limit. Request a new code if needed.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait up to ten minutes before trying again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the fields and try again.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: This request could not be verified. Reload and try again.
errors.SMS_NOT_CONFIGURED: SMS delivery is not configured on this server. Contact the project owner or use the sample prototype.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.ONBOARDING_ORDER: Complete the earlier setup steps first.
errors.INVALID_QR_IMAGE: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image no larger than 300 KB.
errors.PINCODE_NOT_FOUND: No nearby PIN could be suggested. Enter it manually.
errors.fallback: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: The database is unavailable. Please reconnect and try again.

accountBody: Screen preferences update on this device. Save them to your account to use them on your next sign-in.
